Details  
 Lucky B Bucking tee is a classic western t shirt built for everyday wear with soft fabric and bold rodeo style. The Lucky B Bucking tee features the Kimes Ranch logo in a western font with a bucking rider graphic. The design celebrates rodeo heritage and classic western tradition.
 This shirt is part of a collaboration with Lucky B Designs. Each piece reflects western craftsmanship and the spirit of the American West. The artwork represents dedication, skill, and the heritage behind true cowboy culture.
 The cotton blend fabric makes this western t shirt lightweight, breathable, and comfortable for long days. The relaxed fit allows easy movement while still holding its shape through daily wear. This shirt works well at the barn, at work, or at the rodeo.
 The soft hand print keeps the graphic smooth without feeling heavy. Durable construction helps the shirt keep its fit after repeated washing. Built for everyday use, the Lucky B Bucking tee delivers comfort, durability, and authentic ranch style.
 This western t shirt pairs easily with Kimes Ranch jeans, ranch hats, and hoodies. The Lucky B Bucking tee is made for work, travel, rodeos, and everyday life.
